features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: Referring to the drawing, the numeral 10 designates generally a conical suction member comprising a body portion 11 and a rim portion 12 formed of resilient material, preferably rubber.
features.note: The quote describes a rim portion made of resilient material, which functions as a flexible sealing lip.
features.refuted: The quote describes the material and general shape of the suction member but does not mention a 'flexible sealing lip' or its function in bounding a sealed region against a workpiece.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: This invention relates to a vacuum cup or vacuum lifter which is particularly adapted for use in lifting and handling smooth sheets of material such as sheets of steel, glass, and the like.
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum lifter that is operated by a single hand and appears to be a self-contained unit without external hoses or cords, as implied by its description as a 'vacuum cup or vacuum lifter' and its operation by 'the hand of the operator'.
features.refuted: The quote describes the intended use of the vacuum cup (lifting smooth sheets) but does not provide any information about its portability, whether it's single-handed, or if all components are carried by a rigid body without external hoses or cords.

overall.why: The reference describes a handheld vacuum lifter with a resilient sealing rim and a manual release mechanism, sharing some broad functional aspects with the subject invention, but lacks key features like an electric vacuum pump, integrated battery power, and vacuum monitoring with warning indicators
